meta.name: how-it-works
meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

copy.tagline: 解释 claude-mem 的工作原理与数据存储方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问 claude-mem 如何工作或数据存哪里
copy.tagline_en: Explain how claude-mem works and where data is stored
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how claude-mem works or where data lives

howto.what: 装上后，被问到 claude-mem 原理时，Claude 会解释：每次读取、编辑、Bash 操作都被压成观察，并在会话结束汇总；相关记忆会自动注入后续对话；数据存于本机 ~/.claude-mem，卸载时清除。
howto.when: 当用户问 claude-mem 是如何工作的（如 “how does claude-mem work?”），或问它到底在做什么（如 “what is this thing doing?”）时触发。

say.text: claude-mem 是怎么捕捉到我的操作的？
它什么时候会把记忆自动注入下一次对话？
say.note: Claude 会提到从同一项目的第二个会话开始。

say.text: claude-mem 的数据都存在哪里？

howto.what_en: Claude can explain claude-mem: each Read/Edit/Bash action becomes a compressed observation, summarized at session end; relevant ones are auto-injected into future prompts; data stays in ~/.claude-mem and is removed on uninstall.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks how claude-mem works (e.g., "how does claude-mem work?") or what it is doing ("what is this thing doing?").

say_en.text: How does claude-mem capture what I do?
say_en.note: Claude explains that Read/Edit/Bash actions become observations.

say_en.text: When does it inject memories into the next conversation?
say_en.note: From the second session in the same project.

say_en.text: Where does claude-mem store its data?
